hypotheses.physical_signature_and_transform: Combines four coupled physical operators with exact DTI fractional programming: (1) Roest-Nabighian 3-D magnetic analytic signal sqrt(B3^2 + B9^2) paired with 150 m harmonic upward-continuation depth-persistence |grad TMI_up150| / (|grad TMI| + tau) and vector-consistent Laplace vertical gravity curvature g_zz = -(d_col B18 + d_row B11) to separate deep subvertical basement fault steps from shallow volcanic float; (2) Morris-Byerlee-Kostrov azimuthal slip and dilation tendency tensor projection resolving regional Great Basin WNW-ESE extension (optimal normal strike N22E) and Walker Lane/Humboldt shear onto the multi-physics spin-2 structural strike director (T_d = geod_dilaterate_+ * cos^2(theta - 22 deg), T_s = geod_shearrate * sin^2(2*(theta - 22 deg))); (3) 1-m LiDAR unilateral facing polarity |downface - upface|/(downface + upface + 12)*coh100, sentinel-clean (> -32000) 10-m fluvial k_sn & chi-step transient knickzones, potassic K-vs-Th hydrothermal alteration residual, and absolute-elevation zmean_m (1180-1345 m ASL) contour-parallel Lake Lahontan shoreline suppression; and (4) Selected-At-Random (SAR) alluvial exposure-propensity inverse weighting + Elkan (2001) Bayes subsampling odds recalibration decoded by Minoux-exact Dinkelbach Submodular K3-Supremum Expected-DTI Allocation.
hypotheses.why_unmapped_faults_are_caught: USGS/INGENIOUS Quaternary fault omissions cluster in three regimes directly targeted here: (a) low-relief Holocene alluvial aprons/playas where SAR inverse exposure propensity boosts deep upward-continued magnetic/gravity steps, (b) oblique ENE/NW transfer and accommodation-zone splays captured by Riedel shear tendency T_s, fluvial k_sn knickpoints, and unilateral 1-m LiDAR micro-scarps, and (c) multi-kilometer blind relays where probability-adaptive submodular K3-envelope allocation spaces dots at ~4.2-5.0 px along moderate-confidence strands instead of burning dots at fixed 2.8 px.
hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: (1) Pleistocene Lake Lahontan wave-cut shorelines (1,180-1,345 m ASL), suppressed via zmean_m contour-parallelism; (2) symmetric V-shaped fluvial gullies, suppressed via unilateral 1-m LiDAR |downface - upface| polarity; (3) surficial basalt float and E-W (090 deg) GeoDAWN flight-line leveling seams, suppressed via 150 m upward-continuation attenuation and low normal dilation tendency T_d(90 deg) = 0.14.
hypotheses.how_it_differs_from_repo_and_fleet: H86F-EWCS (0.1723) used only 100 m native bands, isotropic strain invariants, in-quadrant visible training, uncalibrated subsampled tree probabilities, 3.0 px collar, and fixed 2.8 px greedy disc thinning. H86C-KSLB (0.1241) misread Band 6 as magnetic tilt and Band 11/18 as vertical gravity tilt, and lacked Pollard-Segall elastic tip/stepover/shadow fields, Morris-Byerlee tensor projection, Roest upward-continuation persistence, SAR cover propensity, and Dinkelbach submodular K3 allocation.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low-Medium (~18 min wall-clock on 2 vCPUs, < 1.1 GiB peak RSS via float16 memmap streaming and 2-second Minoux lazy-greedy submodular allocator)

hypotheses.title: Thompson-Reid 3-D Vector-Gravity & Analytic-Signal Euler Deconvolution Structural-Index (N=0 vs N=2) Source-Lineation Clustering
specific_layers: Competition Band 13 (iso_grav_anom), pixel-verified Band 18 (+dg/dx_east) & -Band 11 (+dg/dy_north), FFT wavenumber vertical derivative g_z
hypotheses.physical_signature_and_transform: Solves Reid et al. (1990) 3-D Euler homogeneity equations in sliding 9x9 windows for structural index N=0.0 (fault contact with finite throw) versus N=2.0 (line/dike/channel), retaining tight spray-convergent horizontal source clusters (x0, y0) whose inverted source depth z0 agrees within +-35% of Band 15 depth_to_base_surf.
hypotheses.why_unmapped_faults_are_caught: Recovers the true horizontal surface-projection locus of dipping blind intrabasin normal faults where potential-field gradient peaks are displaced 300-900 m downdip from the sub-alluvial fault trace.
hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Non-tectonic Mesozoic pluton/wallrock contacts or pre-Cenozoic thrust ramps lacking Quaternary reactivation.
hypotheses.how_it_differs_from_repo_and_fleet: Zero GEMSDOE86 lanes implement 3-D Euler deconvolution; sibling GEMSDOE40 tested scalar magnetic Euler without vector-gravity (B18, -B11) wavenumber g_z cross-validation or N=0 vs N=2 structural-index rejection.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium (~30 min sliding windowed SVD across 5.17M pixels)

hypotheses.physical_signature_and_transform: Replaces isotropic Gaussian smoothing of shallow 2 m temperature and Na-K-Ca/silica geothermometer anomalies with an upslope Peclet advection-dispersion adjoint operator oriented up hydraulic gradient (-grad zmean_m) onto Band 15 pediment hinge lines and Band 17 clay-cap margins.
hypotheses.why_unmapped_faults_are_caught: Lateral groundwater flow shifts Great Basin geothermal outflow plumes 1-6 km down-gradient into mid-playa discharge marshes; adjoint upslope back-projection relocates the signal onto the concealed upflow fault conduit.
hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Stratigraphically confined warm artesian aquifers discharging at alluvial-fan toe facies pinchouts without fault permeability.
hypotheses.how_it_differs_from_repo_and_fleet: H86C-KSLB and H86D-CTHB smoothed GDR-1391 points isotropically (sigma=8-22 px), misplacing anomaly peaks down-gradient of upflow faults; no repo or sibling lane performs hydraulic-head Peclet adjoint back-projection.

hypotheses.physical_signature_and_transform: High-pass spatial gradient |grad u_dot_z| across < 500 m corridors to detect sharp poroelastic hydraulic-head steps and aseismic creep across concealed fault gouge barriers invisible to ~20 km GPS kriging (Bands 4, 7, 8).
hypotheses.why_unmapped_faults_are_caught: Playa-hosted blind faults (Dixie Valley / Brady's analogues) have zero 1 m LiDAR scarp relief due to active playation but produce sharp InSAR phase-velocity steps where clay-rich fault cores compartmentalize seasonal aquifer deformation.
hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Concentric agricultural or mine dewatering subsidence bowls pinned at stratigraphic aquitard pinchouts.
hypotheses.how_it_differs_from_repo_and_fleet: No GEMSDOE86 or 92-site fleet submission incorporates Sentinel-1 OPERA InSAR displacement gradients; native geodetic bands are smooth kriged GPS strain rates.
